claim2_recording.text:
start_recording produces a LeRobotDataset (parquet + video), which needs lerobot's dataset stack:

  No module named 'lerobot.datasets.lerobot_dataset'

For plain MP4 video under the [sim-mujoco] extra alone, use start_cameras_recording(cameras=..., output_dir=...) instead.

Install the extra that ships it:
  uv pip install 'strands-robots[lerobot]'
